name: schemaemitter-run-target-list-limits
body: Run drops a duplicate target line by exact-case comparison of its repo-relative path, so one file listed in two letter cases on a case-insensitive filesystem is emitted twice, and it reads each listed .sqlproj twice (its own pre-parse, then SqlProjectReader.Read), so a project changed between the reads can still throw; its moduleDirs comparison is exact-case on absolute paths, as csharplib's. Upgrade if the --targets producer can list case variants, or when Read accepts the already-parsed projects.
